added_claims.speaker: Steve Leeman
added_claims.quote: I'm also concerned and I we don't have any data at all because of the shutdown. But we even if the shutdown weren't happening, we wouldn't have data.
added_claims.claim: The tariff hit to small businesses cannot be measured: the government shutdown halted official data, and even normal releases do not capture it, so the weak leg of the economy is largely invisible in the data.

added_claims.speaker: Steve Leeman
added_claims.quote: these uh guys who import the fishing reels made in China and Japan were going to get hit two ways. One was on the import tariff and then on the content of the metal.
added_claims.claim: Importers of goods containing metal pay twice, the country tariff plus the tariff on metal content, so the effective burden on such products is higher than the headline country rate.
added_claims.indicator: country tariff plus metal-content tariff on imported goods
added_claims.testable: partly - margins of importers of metal-content goods vs others

added_claims.speaker: Steve Leeman
added_claims.quote: There were huge tariffs on the import of computer equipment. So, we paid a guy to do the importing from us. So, they arrived in boxes labeled children's clothes and that was exempt.
added_claims.claim: High tariffs create evasion (mislabelling, paid intermediaries), as with computer imports into 1990s Russia, and companies are already finding ways around current US tariffs, so collected rates fall below statutory rates.
added_claims.conditions: high tariffs with exemptions that can be exploited
added_claims.testable: partly - customs revenue vs statutory rate over time

added_claims.speaker: Steve Eisman
added_claims.quote: would any of the political pressure that the president is trying to impose on the Fed be discussed at a Fed meeting? And he he was like adamant about it. He said absolutely not.
added_claims.claim: Former Dallas Fed president Rob Kaplan insists political pressure is never discussed at FOMC meetings; Leeman disagrees in substance, saying the pressure plays in the room without being discussed and the Fed both creates and reacts to the political milieu.

added_claims.quote: I did an interview with him in 2002 about the helicopter. The money was dropped from a helicopter that the Fed had all of these avenues and abilities to fight deflation.
added_claims.claim: Bernanke arrived having already worked out (2002 helicopter-money speech) that the Fed has many tools to fight deflation even at zero rates, which made him suited to launch QE in the financial crisis.

corrections.fix: Steve Leeman: the AI boom pays off only if profits accrue to the users of the technology; he will be convinced when the market pays multiples on users, not on the investment.

corrections.issue: wrong speaker: Leeman continues on intercompany pricing as a tariff fudge factor
